rule: Catalogue: league tiers are exactly 1 to 10 and match the game's league table (Bronze never demotes, Diamond never promotes); achievement thresholds strictly increase with the level; slot 1 holds the single daily-goal quest; the shop sells heart_refill and streak_freeze.

cases.name: nine-league-tiers
cases.expect: catalog.json › leagues: league tiers must be exactly 1 to 10, in order

cases.name: bronze-demotes
cases.expect: catalog.json › leagues: tier 1 must be Bronze (promote 20, demote 0)

cases.name: diamond-promotes
cases.expect: catalog.json › leagues: tier 10 must be Diamond (promote 0, demote 5)

cases.name: thresholds-not-increasing
cases.expect: catalog.json › achievements[0]: tier thresholds must strictly increase with the level

cases.name: levels-out-of-order
cases.expect: catalog.json › achievements[5]: tier levels must run 1, 2, 3... in order

cases.name: two-quests-in-slot-1
cases.expect: catalog.json › quests: slot 1 holds exactly one quest, the only daily_goal_xp quest

cases.name: daily-goal-outside-slot-1
cases.expect: catalog.json › quests: slot 1 holds exactly one quest, the only daily_goal_xp quest

cases.name: daily-goal-with-a-target
cases.expect: catalog.json › quests[0]: the daily-goal quest has no target, and every other quest has one

cases.name: unknown-title-placeholder
cases.expect: catalog.json › quests[1]: titleTemplate may only use the {n} placeholder

cases.name: shop-without-streak-freeze
cases.expect: catalog.json › shopItems: the shop must sell streak_freeze

cases.name: shop-without-heart-refill
cases.expect: catalog.json › shopItems: the shop must sell heart_refill

cases.name: boost-without-duration
cases.expect: catalog.json › shopItems[3]: an XP boost has durationMinutes, and no other item does
